name: bebetenkite-dashboard
description: Dashboard de Vendas Bebetenkite - Next.js + Node.js

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:pcp-api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/pcp-api
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web" "npm run start:pcp-api"
